milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The player must navigate toward the yellow concrete structure (centered at ~13, 2, 11 spawn-relative) and face it. max_distance=10 ensures the player has moved significantly from spawn toward the structure (~14 blocks away). facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is actually looking at the structure, modeling 'the player can see the target'.

Uses count_in_box_at_least (kind='block') because this is a place/build task. The player must place at least 1 red_carpet block inside or immediately near the yellow concrete structure. The detection box [11,0,9] to [16,1,14] covers the structure interior (oak plank floor at ~13-14, 0, ~11-12) plus a generous ±2-3 block margin, while excluding the spawn area to prevent false positives from random carpet placement elsewhere.
